name: TJWA_TC_TBH_003 - Clicking each HP chip redirects to the correct HP listing page
fullName: TJWA_TC_TBH_003 - Clicking each HP chip redirects to the correct HP listing page
description:
Verify clicking each HP chip navigates to the corresponding tractor listing page by HP range.

Expected: Each HP chip redirects to the correct URL (e.g., Under 20 HP → /tractors/under-20-hp).
